scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @smart-path/api" "npm run dev -w @smart-path/web"
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @smart-path/api -- --exclude test/auth.test.ts --exclude test/**/*.integration.test.ts --exclude test/**/*.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run test -w @smart-path/api -- --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism --hookTimeout=120000 test/auth.test.ts test/rls.integration.test.ts test/platform-admin-bootstrap.integration.test.ts test/resources.integration.test.ts test/resource-scan-jobs.integration.test.ts test/resource-scan.e2e.test.ts test/question-versions.integration.test.ts test/question-search.integration.test.ts test/question-import.integration.test.ts test/lesson-lifecycle.integration.test.ts test/assignment-lifecycle.integration.test.ts test/exam.integration.test.ts test/dashboard.integration.test.ts test/report-export-jobs.integration.test.ts test/skill-graph.integration.test.ts test/adaptive.integration.test.ts test/career.integration.test.ts test/rag.integration.test.ts test/billing.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:stack:build: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e up --build --wait app-test
scripts.test:e2e:stack:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e up --no-build --wait app-test
scripts.test:e2e:isolated: npm run test:e2e:stack:build && node scripts/with-test-env.mjs npm run test:e2e:browser -w @smart-path/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:web && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build -w @smart-path/contracts && npm run build -w @smart-path/api && npm run build -w @smart-path/web && npm run check:bundle
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @smart-path/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @smart-path/api && npm run typecheck -w @smart-path/web
